blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines —Seven individuals, who were arrested in separate anti-drug operations in Cebu and Bohol, have remained in police and anti-drug agency custody as of Thursday, September 17. This was after authorities shut down two suspected drug dens and confiscated suspected shabu with an estimated value of P1,411,748. The operations, conducted last Tuesday, September 15, were conducted separately by the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in Central Visayas (PDEA-7) and the Philippine National Police (PNP).
